name: Changshu Fengfan Power Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Changshu Fengfan Power Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the production of angle steel tower, steel pipe composite tower, pipes, transformer substation structure support, steel pipe pole, and various steel structure parts for transmission lines in China. The company is involved in the production and sale of cold-formed steel, square and rectangular steel pipes, and steel structural parts; the sale of lubricating oil, diesel oil, fuel oil, asphalt, and chemical products; asset and investment management; overseas and domestic bidding projects; and the import and export of goods and technology.
